## Bio

Hi, my name is Surafel! I am a third year statistics and data science student at UT Austin, also pursuing the Programming and Computation certificate. I am currently doing research on sensitivity analysis methods for surrogate marker validation, and some of my other research interests are econometrics and causal inference in observational settings. In my free time, I enjoy cooking, watching movies, and reading.<br>
